titles.romaji: Pocari Sweat web movie: Hataraku Saibou Dai 11.5-wa Necchuushou - Moshimo Pocari Sweat ga Attara
titles.native: ポカリスエットweb movie｜はたらく細胞第11.5話熱中症～もしもポカリスエットがあったら～

description: An original story collaboration with Otsuka Pharmaceutical that added new animation and dialogue to the existing of Cells at Work!'s ep11. Created to promote understanding of heat stroke and to let people know the importance of taking proactive measures, in response to the record high of emergency transports due to heat stroke in the summer of 2018.
